mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, residential construction (HOUST) exceeding 1000 thousand units signals strong housing demand and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST above 1000 is followed by negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 signals robust manufacturing output and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 110.0 is followed by negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 6.5% is followed by positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments, a sustained CPIAUCSL above 220.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation environments, CPIAUCSL above 220.0 is followed by positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.
